notes.title: Happy ho-ho-holidays!
notes.content:
Happy ho-ho-holidays, travelers!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36808015/65333e8fd7680252e6641e9c09d2da3b8f2fd4f2.png

By Everlight, what's this? It looks like Yui's hometown village has been decorated for the holidays!

We're excited to announce that the YesterMorrow Christmas event is now live!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36808015/b0fbbb06859403857668a930d6357ec47be2000b.png

From a newly decorated title screen, to snow and garlands around the houses in Yui's village, to your own Christmas tree! This update will make sure that you start feeling festive!

Just make sure to update your game to get all of this!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36808015/633633d4f48d723ff7ac987f1cdf6c034da9ad44.png

Get YesterMorrow now!

If you haven't tried the game yet, now is the time for it! Not only you will get the Christmas update, but the game is also currently on sale! So you can get it with 35% off!

YesterMorrow is a single-player time travelling 2D platformer, mixing action sequences with puzzle elements, all wrapped up in an engaging story about our young hero, Yui, who must save her family and to change the fate of a world that has been plunged into endless night.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1210490/YesterMorrow/
